blurb: Guests enjoy fully private charters aboard the 37-foot Carolina Moon catamaran or a 17-foot RIB for eco tours. Snorkeling is in calm, shallow, often wadeable waters with gear and flotation provided, suitable for all ages and swimming abilities. Sunset cruises include champagne toasts and are timed for the best views.
extraNote: Deposit required to hold date; balance due day of trip (full payment required if within 3 days) · Rates exclude 7.5% FL tax, 4% card fee, and 18% crew gratuity (added at checkout) · Captain makes final call on safety; cancellations for weather before departure typically no fee, with reschedule or refund · 18% crew gratuity included in rates; no need for cash tip · Private bayside pickups between MM92 and MM103 in Key Largo; port of call at Bayside Grille, MM99 bayside if no private dock
